title: Lane lint waits under the load brake before it starts
why: Consultant 12:14 CST Nov 17 (relayed to triage 11). A mistake of the consultant's: it ran six lane lints at once, load reached 22, and timing tests failed falsely on 5 PRs (about an hour lost).
source: Consultant message 12:14 CST Nov 17 via send_message; not re-measured by triage.
note: Todo. Guard: `merge --lane-lint` waits under the load brake before it starts, so a lint never starts while the machine is over the brake. The consultant builds it after #3621 (WordsSpeed tests measure CPU time). Prior work (triage 11 read at 12:15 CST): lane-lint-parallel-cap (doing, #2749) and lane-lint-cpu-slots (ready) count slots per CPU, not machine load; lane-lint-load-timeout (ready) is about a verdict under load, not a wait before start; sim-lease-load-brake is the simulator lease. The builder checks these four for overlap first and adds to one if the fix fits there. Guard or check: yes; review rounds apply. 13:22 CST Nov 17 (owner chat answer, relayed by the consultant; not read by triage as typed): should cloud disk and load cleanliness be mechanized, a) one brake at lint start, b) a sweep at session start, c) both? Owner: "What's the best mechanical choice from your options -- I lean towards just A?" The consultant confirmed a. So this step also refuses a lint when free disk is under a floor, and names the sweep (own scratch copies and leftover lint checkouts of each session). The consultant builds it after #3621. Process-only until the PR merges.
